channel.title: Yaprflow Updates
channel.description: Signed updates for Yaprflow for Mac.

item.description:
# Yaprflow 5.2.22
- Prevents meeting capture from unnecessarily lowering the volume of other people speaking on the Mac. - Makes repeated manual update checks safe while another update check is already running. - Hardens audio processing, meeting-note editing, storage, and AI requests so unexpected input produces a recoverable error instead of closing the app.
Speech recognition remains on-device and raw audio is not saved.

# Yaprflow 5.2.21
- Fixes Auto-paste permission setup so macOS shows the correct prompt and can paste completed dictation at the current cursor. - Keeps the finished text on the clipboard when permission has not yet been granted.
Speech recognition remains on-device and raw audio is not saved. Auto-paste uses macOS permission only to send the standard Paste shortcut to the app you are currently using.

# Yaprflow 5.2.20
- Allows a modifier key such as Option to be used by itself as the Quick Dictation shortcut. A quick press and release toggles dictation, while normal Option-key combinations continue to work in other apps. - Adds an optional Auto-paste setting that inserts completed dictation at the current cursor after copying it to the clipboard. - Guides you through granting Accessibility access when Auto-paste needs it.
Speech recognition remains on-device and raw audio is not saved. Auto-paste uses macOS Accessibility access only to send the standard Paste shortcut to the app you are currently using.
